# Fever of the Bones Thriller Collection by Litera

Dive into a gripping new crime fiction experience with *Febra oaselor* (Fever of the Bones), the latest addition to the highly acclaimed thriller collection from Litera. This intense novel plunges readers into a dark mystery, blending high-tech elements with classic police procedural suspense.

## An Unsettling Mystery Awaits

When the only solution seems to be violence, the stakes are impossibly high. The plot centers around a terrifying criminal who commits heinous acts driven by perverse desires, leaving no trace and showing no mercy toward youthful innocence.

The shocking murder and mutilation of adolescent Jennifer Maidment set off an investigation that quickly expands beyond a single crime. Dr. Tony Hill soon realizes that this is not an isolated incident; he is facing the first case in a disturbing campaign targeting a group of seemingly unrelated young people, manipulated by a sophisticated online social network. This chilling new mystery forces the renowned psychologist and profiler, Tony Hill, to confront haunting echoes from his own past.

If you love psychological thrillers, intricate police investigations, and stories that keep you guessing until the final page, this novel is for you.

## Critical Acclaim in Crime Fiction

*Febra oaselor* has garnered rave reviews from major publications, solidifying its place as a must-read in contemporary crime fiction:

*   **The Express:** "McDermid is a first-rate writer, at the height of her career, as demonstrated beautifully in Fever of the Bones."
*   **The Times:** "A brilliant succession of shocks and surprises. McDermid has never been better."
*   **The Guardian:** "McDermid is a true expert at combining hi-tech elements with old-fashioned police tricks. Police novel fans must not miss Fever of the Bones."
*   **The Spectator:** "Jordan and Tony Hill remain, with certainty, the most impressive duo in contemporary crime fiction."

This is a psychological thriller and crime novel, featuring complex investigations into serial crimes targeting young people, focusing on the skills of profiler Dr. Tony Hill.
